description:
Validate and describe one or more Combined Nomenclature codes.

For a single code, returns the full hierarchy of description levels
(`levels`), the resolved `customs_code_label`, and `has_subcodes`. For a
comma-separated list, returns `{"results": [...]}` with one entry per
code (each either a success dict or a `{"customs_code", "error"}` pair).

customs_code.description: One customs code, or a comma-separated list of up to 50 codes (e.g. '73030010, 73030090'). The literal 'TOTAL' is also accepted.

lang.description: Language for translated labels in the response; any other language is refused.

name: validate_customs_code

anyOf.description:
GET /api/reference/validate-customs-code/{customs_code} — a validated
customs code with its description hierarchy.  Also one batch item's
success shape.

customs_code_label.description: The code's display label (the deepest level's text).

has_subcodes.description: Whether the code has children in the current CN edition.

in_current_cn.description: For digit codes: whether the current CN edition lists the code. False for a code known only from its recorded history (expired or abolished).

in_eurostat_api.description: For residual spellings: whether Eurostat's API serves the code as a PRODUCT value (XX codes only).

interpreted_from.description: The raw input, when it was reformatted into customs_code (always the input as typed, never a note).

levels.description: The code's CN description hierarchy (one entry per ancestor level), in the requested language.

items.description:
One level of a customs code's description hierarchy, chapter first
(``ComextNomenclature.get_description_levels``, plus the synthetic
levels of residual spellings and the dated levels of former editions).

The optional flags are sparse on the wire: present when true, absent
otherwise (the shape of the nomenclature layer's raw dicts).

residual.description: True for the synthetic level of a residual spelling.

segment.description: True for a historical segment's own definition.

customs_code.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

siblings.description: For a catch-all level, the ordinary siblings it excludes.

text.description: The level's label, in the requested language.

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

anyOf.description: The validity window of one customs-code segment (one definition).

valid_from.description: First day of the window, ISO date.

valid_to.description: Last day of the window, ISO date; null while in force.

window.description: For a level read from a dated edition (a former definition, or one of its ancestors as that edition had them): the validity window of the definition shown. Absent for current-edition levels.

items.description:
One sub-code or residual customs code row, shared by breakdown views
(``subcode-compare``, ``concentration-compare``, ``volatility``) and
validation responses (``ValidateCustomsCodeResponse.residual_customs_codes``).

basket_key.description: The key of this row's basket in the payload's per-sub-code maps: the sub-code (read over the parent piece's window), or the entered basket's label.

in_eurostat_api.description: For a residual row: whether Eurostat's API serves the spelling as a PRODUCT value (XX codes only).

label.description: The label of the row's (latest) definition, in the requested language when recorded.

residual_kind.description: For a residual row: 'xx' or 'letter'. Residual rows explain the gap between the sub-codes and the parent, and are pinned outside the top-N ranking.

residual_reason.description: For a letter code or reason group: the reason letter (S, Y, E, I, …).

segments.description: The definitions in force during the basket's window (empty for residual rows and for validation rows).

items.description:
One recorded definition of a customs code: a fact of the
classification metadata, with its window and its own label.

customs_code.description: The customs code the segment defines.

label.description: The segment's own label (the definition in force during its window), in the requested language when available.

label_lang.description: The label's language (English when the requested one is not recorded for this definition).

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

valid_from.description: First day of the segment's validity window, ISO date.

valid_to.description: Last day of the window, ISO date; null for a segment still in force.

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

residual_customs_codes.description: Residual customs codes related to this code: those directly under a digit code (its XX code plus one reason group per reason letter), or the letter codes inside a reason group.

residual_kind.description: Residual class for residual spellings: 'xx' or 'letter' (reason groups report 'letter', the class of the codes they group).

residual_reason.description: The reason letter of a letter code or reason group (S, Y, E, I, …).

residual_spelling.description: The residual spelling's exact shape: 'xx', 'letter' or 'reason_group'.

items.description:
Every recorded definition of one customs code (the CN classification
files), independent of the current edition.

metadata_generation.description: The classification snapshot the history comes from.

items.description:
One recorded definition of a customs code with its direct recorded
links (``SegmentHistoryPayload.segments``).

customs_code.description: The customs code the segment defines.

label.description: The segment's own label (the definition in force during its window), in the requested language when available.

label_lang.description: The label's language (English when the requested one is not recorded for this definition).

recorded_links.description: Direct correspondence edges recorded for this exact definition. An empty list means no recorded direct link -- not that the code never changed (headings have no edges of their own).

items.description: One recorded predecessor/successor edge of an exact segment.

match.description: 'matched' when the endpoint resolves to a recorded segment by its full window, 'unmatched' otherwise (never attached to a guessed segment).

valid_from.description: The other segment's window start, ISO date.

valid_to.description: The other segment's window end, ISO date; null when open.

items.description: One recorded predecessor/successor edge of an exact segment.

match.description: 'matched' when the endpoint resolves to a recorded segment by its full window, 'unmatched' otherwise (never attached to a guessed segment).

valid_from.description: The other segment's window start, ISO date.

valid_to.description: The other segment's window end, ISO date; null when open.

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

valid_from.description: First day of the segment's validity window, ISO date.

valid_to.description: Last day of the window, ISO date; null for a segment still in force.

segment_history.description: Every recorded definition of the code, with direct recorded links; null when no classification history is recorded for it. Use these windows to compose windowed pieces (the basket request form).

anyOf.description:
The comma-separated batch path of validate-customs-code: each item a
success or an error.

results.description: The results, one per input item, in input order.
